decisions.reason: As a core interior-lighting product with a visible recent launch and likely shared platform investment, management would keep backing it and attribute any softer uptake to normal market ramp-up rather than a failed commitment.
Because it was presented as a flagship for the firm's future direction, the strong public commitment and strategic fit make management highly reluctant to withdraw it after only two years.

Although more peripheral than the main building-lighting range, it remains the surviving marine searchlight offering after earlier portfolio pruning, so sunk specialist development and the need to justify that choice favor keeping it while waiting for niche demand to develop.
